# Busy Bun: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-10 · code df6bf53902aa · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Play a little bao bun on a culinary journey: run errands for the neighbours, fill your bun, smash pest nests and reach the steamer across 16 worlds and 118 levels.
**Live:** https://busybun.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/BusyBun · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/busybun/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py busybun` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms since 2026-11-08 (branch `forms`)**: the old version was two Custom-HTML forms with all screens built as JS
  strings (forms/GamePage.html, forms/AdminPage.html in the old `BusyBun` folder). Now pages, menus, dialogs and lists are
  Forms; the canvas game (`bb-engine.js`), drawing (`bb-art.js`), the play HUD/touch stick (`bb-stage.js`) and the level
  editor (`bb-builder.js`) stay JavaScript, wrapped by `Components/Stage`, `Components/LevelBuilder`, `Portrait`,
  `LevelThumb`, `TitleBg`.
- **Game state** lives in `client_code/bun.py` (`bun.st`), loaded once per guest/member (`bun.ensure()`); every page
  draws from it. Actions go through `bun.act(name, ...)`, which calls the `guest_` twin with the browser's progress
  for guests (localStorage `bb.guest.v1`, same key as before), then `router.show()` redraws the page.
- **Addresses**: the old game had only `#` and `#admin`; the hub tabs (`#journey` ... `#badges`) and `#play/<level>`
  are new. Signed out = guest play everywhere; there is no #auth page (Dialogs/SignIn opens over the game).
- **Who is signed in** comes from the existing `admin_whoami` callable (no new server function); `state.me()` is its
  reply. Server code is unchanged except type annotations the validator asked for (Catalog/Admin/Game/Levels dicts,
  `getattr(anvil.server, "session")` in submit_feedback).
- **Admin**: the builder engine fetches `admin_state` through `LevelBuilder._emit` (whitelist ADMIN_CALLS); the page
  hands it its own first copy so it loads once. Territories/Players/Feedback are Forms (`Items/TerritoryEditor`,
  `PlayerRow`, `FeedbackRow`). Leaving the Levels tab with unsaved edits asks first (`LevelBuilder.ok_to_leave`).
- **Look**: app.css = the old tokens and sticker components + every screen's CSS + the design-kit block. Anvil Buttons
  use roles `bb-btn` + `red/green/cream/jade/small/big/block` (aliased to the `.bb-btn` rules). Light only (as before).
  AA fixes: red/green/jade button fills darkened, `--bb-soft` text replaced by `--bb-ink-2`, no eyebrow labels.
- **Tests**: `tools/ui/smoke.js` (guest, new player, admin; starts and pauses a level). The server-test mock reads
  anvil.yaml's db_schema (the old one imported tools/sync_to_anvil.py, which isn't in this layout).
- **App mode** (installed feel, 2026-11-10): head_html `app-mode` block + `server_code/app_mode.py` (manifest) +
  app.css "app mode" block + `tools/app_icons.py` + haptics in bb-kit.js; `?app=1` previews it. Details in the guide.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/app_icons.py`: Render the installed-app icons from the game's own bun drawing (theme/assets/bb-art.js) with headle…
- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/gen_levels.py`: Make worlds 7-16 (100 levels) and write them to server_code/LevelPack.py.
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
